d: Every dbt model is a top-down CTE chain. Subqueries become unreadable past 2 levels.
In every fact, state explicitly what one row represents. Validate with COUNT(*) vs COUNT(DISTINCT pk).
Project explicitly. Schema changes upstream break dashboards silently otherwise.

t: Test the FK at the mart layer
d: relationships test on consumer-facing fact. Use severity: warn to start.
Every model ends with {{ audit_columns() }}. dbt_loaded_at + run_id traces incidents.
WHERE __is_deleted = false on every CDC table. Always.
MERGE on unique_key, never bare INSERT. Backfills must replay safely.
dbt build -s state:modified+ runs only changed models + downstream. 10× faster than full builds.
Code shows what. Description should explain why this column exists, what business concept it encodes.
Structured intent feeds catalogs, AI tools, and future metric views.
dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key with a nullable column collapses NULL-rows. Use guaranteed-unique input.
Fan-out kills sums. GROUP BY one side first, then join — preserves grain.
Hot Delta tables need OPTIMIZE for compaction, ZORDER for high-cardinality filter pruning.
Stats-based broadcasting is unreliable. Use the hint when you know one side is small.
Real-time? Ask what SLO. 5-min micro-batch covers 90% of "real-time" asks at 30% of cost.
Producer agrees a schema; consumer validates it. Schema change = explicit migration, not surprise.
Style is a lint gate. Consistency reduces review time and code-review fatigue.
feat: [DAE-422] Add stg_accounts. Searchable, traceable, automated changelog.
src + stg + downstream in one PR. Reviewers see the full data flow, not isolated pieces.
Rebase your feature branch. Main is sacred — its history is the audit trail.
